description: Has this already been reported? Pass the text you are about to report (and the page, if you know it) before create_item, or an itemId to find what an existing thread duplicates. Returns likely matches with why each matched: shared words, same page, same element, same source file. If two are the same problem, merge_items folds one into the other.

includeResolved.description: Default true: a resolved match may mean it came back. false to skip them.

itemId.description: Instead of text: find duplicates of this item.

page.description: Optional. A page path or URL, e.g. "/checkout".

projectId.description: Optional if a project is bound or itemId is given.

selector.description: Optional. CSS selector of the element.

text.description: What someone is about to report.

name: find_similar
title: Find similar feedback
